ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area (~85%) punctuated by high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips and scattered circular rosettes across the mid-region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous zones are mapped to the extreme distal edges of both lobes. High-contrast circular rings (rosettes) are distributed throughout the medial and lateral regions of both lobes, contrasted against a solid low-intensity black background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree interior angle and a depth of roughly 1/6th the vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged serrations of varying amplitude across the entire trailing edge; higher frequency and intensity of peaks at the outer lobes due to sessile organism colonization.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal sweep beginning with a convex curve at the median notch, transitioning to a slight concave mid-section, and ending in a convex upward lift at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-20 pixel diameter) scattered across the dorsal-medial regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical white linear mark is visible on the right lobe mid-section; smaller horizontal striations are detectable on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the extreme left and right lobe tips, creating high-texture, high-intensity 3D protrusions that alter the geometric edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The presence of living sessile barnacle clusters at the fluke tips creates a 'cauliflower' texture that obscures the underlying pigmentation and edge contour.
